description:
Get full description, amenities, access notes, and policies for a unit.

    Args:
        unit: One of "muckle-meadow-pod", "cosie-coorie-pod", "bb".
              For "bb", returns the 4 rooms plus shared amenities.

    Returns:
        {unit, details: {name, type, size_sqm, amenities, rooms?, ...},
         policies, location}.

unit.description: Which WEE WiLDS unit: "muckle-meadow-pod" (Muckle Meadow Glamping Pod), "cosie-coorie-pod" (Cosy Coorie Pod) or "bb" (the B&B, all 4 rooms).
unit.title: Unit

name: get_unit_details
title: Get unit details
